stem:
The cost of 6 pencils at a store is 30 cents. Each pencil has the same cost.

Which graph has a slope that best represents the cost of each pencil at this store?
visual_elements: Four graphs labeled F, H, G, J all titled 'Cost of Pencils' with x-axis labeled 'Number of Pencils' and y-axis labeled 'Cost (cents)'. Each graph has plotted points showing the relationship between number of pencils and cost in cents.
